name: Castlereagh Wards 1992 (Sheet 1) (Raster)
description: OSNI's printed sheet for the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner's Final Recommendations for District and Wards: 1992, Castlereagh Local Government District, Sheet 1. It shows the recommended ward boundaries (red) over the existing 1985 ones (blue), and the sheet's table gives each recommended ward's electors on the 1991 register. Printed scale 1:10,000. The whole sheet is placed by its main map, so its insets, ward table and key fall where that placement puts them. Georeferenced to OSNI's 1993 ward boundaries with an affine fit (RMS 1.4 m over 22,873 matched boundary points).

references.label: OSNI Open Data - Largescale Boundaries - Wards (1993) - Open Data NI (admin.opendatani.gov.uk)
Review of Local Government Boundaries: Report by the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner, Dr M N Hayes (HMSO, June 1992)
references.note: Final recommendations for the district and ward boundaries used from the 1993 local elections, with ward electorates. Printed report; no online copy found.

references.label: Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 1992 (S.R. 1992 No. 303)
references.note: Made 6 Jul 1992 on the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner's report under section 50 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972, without modification; in force 19 May 1993 (1 Aug 1992 for election proceedings, 1 Apr 1993 for rates). Alters the boundaries of certain districts and the number, names and boundaries of wards.
